_comment: The hand-written half of frame_parity.json: which cross-platform frame disagreements are a platform idiom (category 3), on which fields, and why. `jui conformance frame-parity --update` measures, applies these rules (the first rule whose fixture / id globs match wins; fields: the fields allowed to differ), and writes frame_parity.json. A matched id that also differs OUTSIDE its rule's fields is not ledgered and is named, so a defect cannot ride in with an idiom on the same id. A rule with no fields keeps its ids out on purpose. HAND-MAINTAINED.
